positions.pos: Clothing kit robes have cut-on shoulders, like real hanfu and cultivation robes: sleeve and body are one T-shaped surface with no armhole seam. The sleeve starts as a rounded cap tucked inside the robe body and eased into it.
positions.why: Your round 0 note: "I can see pretty clearly where the seams are going to make weird and boxy intersections." Real robes hide this join by not having one.

positions.pos: Average Dusk gets collarbones (spine, collarbone, upper arm) that lift with about 28% of the arm's rise, shoulder skin blends three or four bones, and clothes are fitted with the arms 45 degrees out, then copy the body's skin weights.
positions.why: The skeleton check found no collarbone, at most two bones per point and 98 of 236 shoulder points tied to one bone, which is why the shoulder could not round. Your note: "This may be an issue with the skeleton."

positions.pos: Any clothing check in motion uses the mocap walk (arcade-walk-r4), not the base walk clip, which flips a leg mid-loop.
positions.why: Found while rendering round 0b's walk loop.

questions.lookTitle: Clothing kit round 0b: shoulders and seams
questions.q: Do the shoulders and seams feel natural enough now to build round 1?
questions.why_you: Round 0b answers your note on round 0. The skeleton was part of it: Average Dusk had no collarbone, so we added collarbones and re-weighted the shoulder. The sleeve is now cut on like a real robe, one surface with no armhole seam, and the robe copies the body's skin so they bend together. Fixes we had made in earlier rounds are carried in: body hidden under clothes, the cuff is the sleeve's own edge, layers no longer poke through. An independent art director checked three times and passes the novice and practitioner; the elder's over-robe still has hairline seams on the back shoulders, a stiff padded shoulder line and a step at the waist. Other known gaps for round 1: the seated skirt is still a flat slab, the knee pushes into the long skirt mid-walk, and trousers peek at the practitioner's front hem. The page has before and after, a walk loop and the check numbers.
